arrival_card.name: Indonesia arrival declarations (by mode of entry)
arrival_card.submission_window: For air/sea arrivals, All Indonesia can be completed from 3 days before arrival or upon landing. Follow the official customs instructions for land arrivals.
arrival_card.notes: Air/sea arrivals: All Indonesia at https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/. Land arrivals: ECD Bea Cukai at https://ecd.beacukai.go.id/. The applicable declaration system depends on the crossing; All Indonesia integrates customs where implemented. These are arrival declarations, separate from visa eligibility.

fields.passport_validity: Passport valid for at least 6 months upon arrival
required_documents: Passport valid for at least 6 months upon arrival
fields.onward_travel_evidence: Present an outbound ticket from Indonesia upon arrival
fields.financial_evidence: Have sufficient living expenses while in Indonesia.
fields.entry_requirements: For air and sea arrivals, complete the All Indonesia arrival declaration at https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/. It integrates immigration, customs, health and quarantine declarations and can be completed from 3 days before arrival or upon landing. For land arrivals, Indonesian Customs directs travellers to the electronic customs declaration at https://ecd.beacukai.go.id/. Follow the declaration system required at your crossing; All Indonesia replaces the separate customs declaration where that system is implemented. Arrival declarations do not replace the applicable visa or exemption.

supporting_evidence.quote: Arrival forms for immigration, customs, health, and quarantine (arrival cards) are now integrated into a single digital system through this application. Passengers can fill out the All Indonesia form three days before arriving in Indonesia from their country of origin and upon landing.

With this integration, international passengers arriving in Indonesia, whether through airports, seaports, or land borders where All Indonesia has been implemented, no longer need to fill out an electronic customs declaration (e-CD), as all customs declaration processes are already combined in this integrated digital system.

Arrival Card Submission is Required All travellers are required to submit an arrival card within 3 (three) days prior arrival in Indonesia
Submit Arrival Card Now
https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/

arrival_card.quote: Kedatangan Melalui Udara dan Laut (Aplikasi All Indonesia) Saat ini, Indonesia menerapkan sistem satu pintu melalui layanan All Indonesia. Layanan ini mengintegrasikan informasi imigrasi, bea cukai (Customs Declaration), kesehatan, hingga karantina dalam satu tautan. Hal ini membuat proses kedatangan menjadi lebih cepat, mudah, dan aman. Akses: allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id Waktu Pengisian: Dapat diisi mulai 3 hari (H-3) sebelum jadwal kedatangan Anda di Indonesia. Cara: Pilih kategori Warga Negara Indonesia atau Pengunjung Asing, lalu ikuti petunjuk pengisian hingga selesai. Kedatangan Melalui Darat dan Keberangkatan Luar Negeri (ECD Bea Cukai) Khusus bagi penumpang yang tiba melalui jalur darat (PLBN) atau penumpang yang akan berangkat ke luar negeri (ekspor) dengan membawa uang tunai (setara Rp100 juta atau lebih) serta barang-barang tertentu lainnya, pengisian formulir dilakukan melalui: Akses: ecd.beacukai.go.id Waktu Pengisian: Dapat diisi mulai 3 hari (H-3) sebelum jadwal kedatangan Anda di Indonesia.

supporting_evidence.quote: Arrival forms for immigration, customs, health, and quarantine (arrival cards) are now integrated into a single digital system through this application. Passengers can fill out the All Indonesia form three days before arriving in Indonesia from their country of origin and upon landing.

With this integration, international passengers arriving in Indonesia, whether through airports, seaports, or land borders where All Indonesia has been implemented, no longer need to fill out an electronic customs declaration (e-CD), as all customs declaration processes are already combined in this integrated digital system.

Arrival Card Submission is Required All travellers are required to submit an arrival card within 3 (three) days prior arrival in Indonesia
Submit Arrival Card Now
https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id/

arrival_card.quote: Kedatangan Melalui Udara dan Laut (Aplikasi All Indonesia) Saat ini, Indonesia menerapkan sistem satu pintu melalui layanan All Indonesia. Layanan ini mengintegrasikan informasi imigrasi, bea cukai (Customs Declaration), kesehatan, hingga karantina dalam satu tautan. Hal ini membuat proses kedatangan menjadi lebih cepat, mudah, dan aman. Akses: allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id Waktu Pengisian: Dapat diisi mulai 3 hari (H-3) sebelum jadwal kedatangan Anda di Indonesia. Cara: Pilih kategori Warga Negara Indonesia atau Pengunjung Asing, lalu ikuti petunjuk pengisian hingga selesai. Kedatangan Melalui Darat dan Keberangkatan Luar Negeri (ECD Bea Cukai) Khusus bagi penumpang yang tiba melalui jalur darat (PLBN) atau penumpang yang akan berangkat ke luar negeri (ekspor) dengan membawa uang tunai (setara Rp100 juta atau lebih) serta barang-barang tertentu lainnya, pengisian formulir dilakukan melalui: Akses: ecd.beacukai.go.id Waktu Pengisian: Dapat diisi mulai 3 hari (H-3) sebelum jadwal kedatangan Anda di Indonesia.
